name: Accurateedge
headline: Accurate Edge UAE
lede: Accurate Edge UAE delivers precision CNC machining, deep hole drilling, heat treatment and industrial coating services in Dubai.
about: We are among the manufacturing industries known for delivering high-precision machining and advanced welding solutions that meet the strictest industry standards and customer specifications. We also provide CNC machining services UAE, offering end-to-end solutions for clients across engineering and manufacturing industries.

Since the company’s inception in 2007, we have become a trusted manufacturer in UAE, specialising in products manufactured from Alloy, Stainless, Duplex, Super Duplex Steels, and Exotic materials. Our advanced CNC machine shop is equipped to handle a wide variety of custom machining needs, backed by years of expertise in delivering high-precision machining solutions for the manufacturing industry..
